title: HSWM Core Responsibility Ontology v1
authority_boundary: The one-system token-native HSWM target identity and the H/W/A/F/Pi tuple are canonical target identity. Detailed ownership, atomization, seam, and unique-normal-form rules are SECONDARY_AI conceptual-closure candidates. This ontology records those distinctions and does not retroactively attribute them to the user.

excludes: the external world as a whole
MCP or ontology services as HSWM cognition
an empirical efficacy or consciousness claim
scope.admission_boundary: Raw envelopes are rejected, quarantined, or atomized by ingress into typed H/A candidates. W, F, and Pi changes require their dedicated authorized transition families. Unknown and ambiguous kinds never default to H.

normal_form_contract.name: Versioned Canonical Responsibility Normal Form
normal_form_contract.owner_law: Every admitted primitive atom has exactly one owner role in H/W/A/F/Pi; other roles use typed references rather than a second source of truth.
normal_form_contract.state_form: S_t=(H_t,W_t,A_t,F_t,Pi_t), with disjoint canonical ownership and dependent typed composition.
normal_form_contract.raw_boundary: Raw = Reject | Quarantine | Admit typed H/A candidates; W/F/Pi mutations occur only through dedicated authorized lifecycle transitions.
normal_form_contract.presentation_uniqueness: Equivalent finite discrete presentations should normalize to one representative up to role-preserving isomorphism after termination, confluence, and exact canonical labeling are established.
normal_form_contract.continuous_uniqueness: Continuous W/F coordinates are unique only modulo an explicitly declared gauge; no stable global coordinate section is claimed.
normal_form_contract.schema_evolution: A new primitive kind requires exactly one existing owner and a versioned migration. A sixth owner requires constitutional review and a new ontology major version.

roles.name: Persistent relational world and lineage
roles.canonical_meaning: Durable identities, records, provenance, role-bearing n-ary hyperedges, and committed incidence topology.
owns: entity, event, claim, evidence, judgment, outcome, and provenance records
artifact, tool, and function-cell identity records

roles.name: Learned macro-synaptic disposition
roles.canonical_meaning: Operator-valued semantic transport, fast and slow causal efficacy, learned routing disposition, and topology propensity.
owns: fast and slow learned causal efficacy

roles.name: Episode-local realized activation
roles.canonical_meaning: Current token activation, bounded frontier, chosen route, cell invocation, used path, and pre-outcome eligibility.

roles.name: Typed LLM-executed semantic function
roles.canonical_meaning: Local typed nonlinear semantic cell definitions and their executable port, parser, and configuration contracts.
must_not_own: deterministic tools treated as LLM cells

roles.name: Constitutional and operational boundary
roles.canonical_meaning: Identity-bearing constitutional limits and versioned capability, consent, budget, transaction, rollback, provenance-integrity, and safety enforcement.
owns: budget, transaction, rollback, and safety enforcement

primitive_kinds.name: StableEntityVersion
primitive_kinds.definition: A versioned identity record with explicit lineage and scope.

primitive_kinds.name: EventRecord
primitive_kinds.definition: A durable occurrence record distinct from its current activation.

primitive_kinds.name: ClaimRecord
primitive_kinds.definition: A scoped remembered claim that is not automatically truth.

primitive_kinds.name: EvidenceRecord
primitive_kinds.definition: A source-bound evidence record with explicit provenance.

primitive_kinds.name: JudgmentRecord
primitive_kinds.definition: A scoped evaluator judgment record separated from permission and learned weight.

primitive_kinds.name: OutcomeRecord
primitive_kinds.definition: An externally attributable outcome record bound to a trajectory when justified.

primitive_kinds.name: ProvenanceLink
primitive_kinds.definition: A typed lineage, derivation, correction, fork, merge, or supersession relation.

primitive_kinds.name: HyperedgeVersion
primitive_kinds.definition: A committed n-ary relation version whose grouping is canonical.

primitive_kinds.name: IncidenceVersion
primitive_kinds.definition: A reified member-role-direction incidence preserving multiplicity and optional order.

primitive_kinds.name: ArtifactIdentity
primitive_kinds.definition: A stable source, tool, model, or function-cell artifact identity and digest record.

primitive_kinds.name: OperatorFamily
primitive_kinds.definition: A typed role-aware semantic transport family for a relation kind.

primitive_kinds.name: SemanticTransportState
primitive_kinds.definition: A learned relation- and recipient-conditioned transport state.

primitive_kinds.name: CausalEfficacyState
primitive_kinds.definition: Fast and slow outcome-bound causal disposition, not truth or permission.

primitive_kinds.name: TopologyPropensity
primitive_kinds.definition: A learned soft gate proposing whether a relation should become active topology.

primitive_kinds.name: ActivationPacket
primitive_kinds.definition: A current typed token signal and its bounded local activation state.

primitive_kinds.name: EpisodeFrontier
primitive_kinds.definition: The finite current activation frontier and coalition boundary.

primitive_kinds.name: RouteDecision
primitive_kinds.definition: The route actually selected under H, W, F, and Pi for one episode step.

primitive_kinds.name: FunctionCellInvocation
primitive_kinds.definition: One realized invocation of an F cell with an exact typed input and state cut.

primitive_kinds.name: EligibilitySeal
primitive_kinds.definition: A used-path and propensity record sealed before its outcome is known.

primitive_kinds.name: CompiledActiveCut
primitive_kinds.definition: A finite episode-local lossless execution handle compiled from canonical state.

primitive_kinds.name: FunctionCellDefinition
primitive_kinds.definition: A typed local nonlinear semantic transformation executed by an LLM.

primitive_kinds.name: PortContract
primitive_kinds.definition: The executable typed semantic input/output interface of a function cell.

primitive_kinds.name: SemanticParserContract
primitive_kinds.definition: A bounded parser contract for converting LLM output into typed semantic proposals.

primitive_kinds.name: FunctionCellConfiguration
primitive_kinds.definition: A bounded executable configuration referencing H-owned artifact identity.

primitive_kinds.name: ConstitutionalBoundary
primitive_kinds.definition: The identity-bearing Pi-star boundary ordinary learning cannot weaken.

primitive_kinds.name: OperationalPolicy
primitive_kinds.definition: A versioned and revocable operational policy under explicit mandate.

primitive_kinds.name: AuthorityGrant
primitive_kinds.definition: An effective scoped authority grant distinct from an H-recorded authority claim.

primitive_kinds.name: ConsentGrant
primitive_kinds.definition: An effective scoped consent grant with withdrawal semantics.

primitive_kinds.name: CapabilityGrant
primitive_kinds.definition: A scoped capability to read, activate, invoke, act, update, export, or erase.

primitive_kinds.name: BudgetLease
primitive_kinds.definition: A finite time- and resource-bounded operational lease.

primitive_kinds.name: TransactionPolicy
primitive_kinds.definition: Atomic admission, commit, conflict, and replay rules.

primitive_kinds.name: RollbackPolicy
primitive_kinds.definition: The authorized forward transition that reactivates a prior state root without deleting history.

primitive_kinds.name: OpaquePermit
primitive_kinds.definition: A non-forgeable subject/action/object/scope/base-root-bound authorization bearer.

relation_types.definition: Connects a canonical hyperedge version to a reified incidence version.
Connects an incidence version to the stable entity version occupying its typed role.
A typed non-owning reference from one canonical primitive kind to another.
Marks a new record or projection as derived from a source without transferring ownership.
Binds a pre-outcome eligibility seal to an independently recorded outcome.
Requires a Pi-owned effective permit or policy for a transition.
Declares a state-transition family's typed read dependency.
Declares a state-transition family's possible canonical write target.
Produces a bounded execution or readout projection from canonical state.
Explicitly forbids a projection from becoming canonical state without fresh typed admission.

seam_contracts.name: Committed topology to learned disposition
requirements: Every W edge/version reference resolves to an H-owned committed hyperedge version.
W=0 or a closed soft gate does not delete the H edge.

seam_contracts.name: Persistent world to current activation
requirements: Every activated entity, edge, artifact, and source references an admitted H version.
Archiving A creates a new H record; it never retags the same atom.

seam_contracts.name: Weight snapshot to realized route
requirements: A binds the exact W snapshot used for routing.
Eligibility is sealed before the outcome and remains A-owned until archived.

seam_contracts.name: Cell contract to invocation
requirements: Every invocation resolves to an F cell and matching typed port contract.
Invocation state is A-owned rather than embedded in the F definition.

seam_contracts.name: Artifact identity to executable semantic cell
requirements: F references H-owned artifact identity, digest, and provenance.
Replacing an executor does not silently rewrite H identity or lineage.

seam_contracts.name: Inter-cell transport to local nonlinear cell
requirements: W transport and F local transition meet only through named typed ports.
A cell replacement intervention must not silently absorb or rewrite the W source of truth.

seam_contracts.name: Effective authority to current action
requirements: Every privileged activation, invocation, tool call, and action binds an effective permit.
A learned score cannot compensate for Pi denial.

seam_contracts.name: Constitutional boundary to durable world state
requirements: Canonical H changes require a base-root-bound Pi admission or commit decision.
H records policy assertions and history, while Pi owns the effective grant.

seam_contracts.name: Constitutional boundary to learned disposition
requirements: Durable W changes require a base-root-bound Pi commit decision.
No learned reward or weight can weaken Pi-star or manufacture permission.

seam_contracts.name: Constitutional boundary to executable semantic cell
requirements: Registering, replacing, or invoking an F cell remains within an effective capability and typed admission scope.
F output cannot issue its own authority or final commit permit.

transition_families.name: IngressAdmission
transition_families.definition: Reject, quarantine, or atomize an external envelope into typed H records and episode-local A candidates only.
effect_constraints: Ingress never writes W, F, or Pi.
Unknown or ambiguous input remains rejected or quarantined rather than defaulting to H.

transition_families.name: EpisodeStep
transition_families.definition: Advance a bounded token activation through exact H/W/F revisions under Pi and record only the realized episode-local A path.
effect_constraints: Every A atom remains episode-local and references exact H/W/F/Pi revisions.
Eligibility is sealed before any attributable outcome and cannot be backfilled.

transition_families.name: EpisodeClose
transition_families.definition: Close or expire episode-local A without retagging any A atom as durable H.
effect_constraints: Closing A creates no durable learning by itself.
Durable archival, if separately admitted, creates a new H atom and never reuses an A UID.

transition_families.name: OutcomeBoundLearning
transition_families.definition: Bind an already recorded attributable outcome to a pre-outcome eligibility seal, validate a candidate, and conditionally commit new H/W versions while only consuming and closing that seal in A.
effect_constraints: The eligibility payload was sealed before the outcome and is never rewritten after it.
The only A write is one-way consumption and closure of the exact seal.
Ordinary learning never writes F or Pi.

transition_families.name: TopologyRewrite
transition_families.definition: Promote, split, merge, supersede, specialize, or separate committed H topology through one outcome-bound authorized mutation plane.
effect_constraints: A W topology propensity is only a proposal and cannot directly create or delete H incidence.
Every topology change creates immutable H revisions with lineage and preserves n-ary incidence semantics.

transition_families.name: FunctionCellLifecycle
transition_families.definition: Register or replace an executable F cell and its typed contracts under exact artifact provenance and Pi admission.
effect_constraints: F registration and replacement require exact capability, artifact digest, and typed port/parser admission.
An F output cannot authorize its own registration, replacement, invocation, or commit.

transition_families.name: OperationalPolicyLifecycle
transition_families.definition: Issue, supersede, revoke, expire, or consume operational Pi policy and grants without changing Pi-star.
effect_constraints: Operational policy and grants are versioned, scoped, revocable, and non-self-authorizing.
This transition cannot amend Pi-star.

transition_families.name: ConstitutionalAmendment
transition_families.definition: Create a new Pi-star constitutional boundary revision only through explicit ratification with durable H lineage.
effect_constraints: Only this transition may write Pi-star.
Ordinary learning, policy lifecycle, F lifecycle, topology rewrite, and rollback cannot substitute for explicit ratification.

transition_families.name: Rollback
transition_families.definition: Create new forward H/W/F revisions whose content is derived from prior revisions while preserving all Pi and never reusing historical A atoms.
effect_constraints: Rollback is a new forward event with new UIDs and explicit derivation lineage, never an in-place rewind.
Rollback never reuses, revives, or retags any historical A atom.
Rollback writes no Pi kind; policy or constitutional change uses its dedicated transition.

projection_classes.name: TypedIncidenceProjection
projection_classes.definition: A role-colored entity/hyperedge/incidence graph preserving n-ary grouping, multiplicity, direction, and order.

projection_classes.name: CompiledActiveCutProjection
projection_classes.definition: A finite query/capability cut compiled for execution and reproducible from canonical roots.

projection_classes.name: ReadoutProjection
projection_classes.definition: A fallible human- or agent-readable phenotype with source, scope, authority, and loss declaration.

projection_classes.name: RetrievalIndexProjection
projection_classes.definition: A rebuildable clique, pairwise, embedding, vector, or search index that never replaces canonical n-ary H.

projection_classes.name: RepositoryOntologyProjection
projection_classes.definition: A repository navigation and research map, not HSWM runtime cognition, routing, or learning.

invariants.statement: Every admitted primitive kind has an owner role.
invariants.validation: Reject any primitive kind without owner_role_uid.

invariants.statement: Every admitted primitive kind has exactly one owner role.
invariants.validation: owner_role_uid is scalar and must resolve to exactly one of the five role UIDs.

invariants.statement: A non-owner role references a foreign source of truth rather than embedding a second authoritative copy.
invariants.validation: Foreign-owner payload fields fail admission unless explicitly marked derived and rebuildable.

invariants.statement: Unknown or ambiguous primitive kinds are quarantined rather than guessed.
invariants.validation: Strict decoding rejects excess and unknown kinds before semantic admission.

invariants.statement: Canonical H preserves reified n-ary incidence, member roles, multiplicity, direction, and declared order.
invariants.validation: Lossy clique or 2-section projections cannot commit back.

invariants.statement: H owns committed incidence existence and W owns learned soft topology propensity.
invariants.validation: Changing W propensity alone cannot create or delete a canonical H edge.

invariants.statement: A is episode-local; durable archival creates a new H record with derivation lineage.
invariants.validation: The same atom UID cannot change owner from A to H.

invariants.statement: Pi denial cannot be overridden by reward, W score, or F output.
invariants.validation: Denied privileged transitions produce no canonical state change.

invariants.statement: A durable learned W/H/routing change requires pre-outcome eligibility, attributable outcome, validation, and Pi commit.
invariants.validation: Transcript retention or candidate creation alone is not recorded as learning.

invariants.statement: This ontology, repository organization, MCPs, readouts, and indexes are bounded projections or interfaces rather than HSWM cognition.
Learning/update U is a transition family and not a sixth state component.
invariants.validation: The canonical role symbol set remains exactly H/W/A/F/Pi.

invariants.statement: Responsibility uniqueness is relative to this versioned schema and declared equivalences, not a universal metaphysical theorem.
invariants.validation: The normal-form status remains an engineering target until termination, confluence, roundtrip, and intervention preservation are evidenced.

external_anchors.use: Reuse the existing token-hypergraph core identity without redefining it.
Reuse the existing proposed relational-ontology principle.
Reuse the existing USER_PRIMARY Occam-minimization direction.
Reuse the existing computational/constitutional two-boundary candidate.

source_bindings.binding_scope: role-bearing n-ary H, operator-valued W, derived z/U channels, dual planes
current L0 evidence and open L1 target boundary

kg_projection_policy.hypergraph_encoding: Reify entity, hyperedge, and incidence nodes; never replace canonical n-ary grouping with a clique.
kg_projection_policy.future_publisher_gate: A Neo4j or other KG publisher requires separate schema-registry review, explicit apply authority, and exact source-hash revalidation.

nonclaims: This ontology is not the HSWM runtime graph or cognitive state.
The repository ontology and MCPs are not HSWM routing or learning.
H/W/A/F/Pi are not five independent subsystems.
This v1 taxonomy does not prove a universal or natural five-part ontology.
Canonical labeling does not remove continuous W/F gauge freedom.
A graph projection, prompt, transcript, or stored token is not durable learning by itself.
No current checked-in evidence establishes integrated L1 HSWM causal macro-learning.
No remote KG write or schema-registry mutation is authorized by this bundle.
